Separating calibration and query graph inputs does not prove population independence. Callers must prevent training/calibration/query leakage and justify unseen-class membership. Font-only synthetic classes test routing structure, not zero-shot accuracy.

Current adapters have fixed architectures and class widths. Checkpoint paths require a provisioned trusted local filesystem; model-only checkpoints do not resume optimizer/RNG history.
